home_desc: Share ideas, get answers and talk with other LixBuds, Lixney and Lixfly users.
step1_b: You only need an email to post, comment and like.
login_or_create: Log in or create an account
step2_b: Tell us your question, idea or showcase in the space that fits best.
step3_b: Reply to others, like posts and share the threads that help you.
rules_p: An automatic filter blocks insults, offensive language, threats and self-harm content. The team reviews reports and can remove content that breaks the rules.
dsa_p: If you find illegal content (DSA), email us at {email} with the link and the reason, or use the {contact}.
privacy_p: Your public profile and what you post are visible to everyone. See what data we process and your rights in the {policy}.
search_desc: Search Lixby community threads by text, space or tag.
search_lead: Find threads by title, content, space or tag.
search_cap: Searched within a window of {n} threads; refine the filters if you can't find something.
no_threads_space: There are no threads in this space yet. Be the first!
thread_locked: Thread closed: it no longer accepts new comments.
thread_many_comments: Showing the first comments of the thread.
rules_page_desc: Rules for taking part, automatic moderation, consequences and the reporting channel of the Lixby community.
rules_lead: Rules for taking part, moderation and reporting.
n_allowed_1: Questions and doubts about LixBuds, Lixney, Lixfly and the rest of Lixby products and services.
n_allowed_3: Bug reports with the steps to reproduce them.
n_allowed_4: Samples of your projects and creations (showcase).
n_allowed_5: Helping other users with useful information and respect.
n_notallowed_1: Insults, put-downs, harassment or hate speech.
n_notallowed_4: Spam, unsolicited advertising and misleading links.
n_notallowed_5: Illegal content or content that infringes third-party rights.
n_auto_p: To keep a respectful space, Lixby uses an automatic filter that blocks messages with insults, offensive language, threats or self-harm content. If your message is not published for this reason, you will see an immediate notice and can rewrite it. Blocked text is not stored.
n_cons_1: The automatic filter blocks the message right away.
n_cons_2: The team can remove content that breaks these rules.
n_cons_3: Serious or repeated cases can lead to account suspension.
n_claim_p: If you think a moderation decision is wrong, or you want to report content (including illegal content, under the DSA), email us at {email} with the link to the content and the reason. You can also use the {contact}.
n_privacy_p: Your public profile and what you post are visible to everyone. See what data we process and your rights in the {policy}.
err_resource_exhausted: You've done too many actions in a row. Try again later.
err_permission_denied: You don't have permission for this action.
err_not_found: The content is no longer available.
err_failed_precondition: This action isn't available right now.
err_invalid_argument: Check the details and try again.
err_unavailable: The service isn't available. Try again later.
verify_text: Verify your email to take part. We sent you a link when you signed up.
resend_sent: Email sent. Check your inbox (and the spam folder).
profile_title: Choose your name in the community
profile_label: It will appear on your threads and comments
